import re
from collections import Counter

anagram_text = "Our brooding Dane in Elsinore weighs noble minds suffering, pondering slings and arrows, and questions of being, while outrageous fortune turns against him."

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', s.lower())

an_letters = normalize(anagram_text)
trial = "To be or not to be that is the question whether tis nobler in mind to suffer slings and arrows of outrageous fortune"
print("Is perfect anagram:", Counter(an_letters) == Counter(normalize(trial)))
